messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error running inla on HPC cluster
parts:
* make sure you have the most recent testing version

* do
inla.binary.install()
and chose another build, like the CentOS7 often works well
on HPC clusters

* If there are still errors, retry with another build.

if everything fails, then let me know

Best
H
